Noah (Finance): FYI inbound from Leah - Cardinal Diagnostics requests a blended price + SLA credit clause for a 9-month pilot. Need deal-desk + legal signoff before we update MSA.
Leah (Sales): They want 20% off list for the pilot, plus a 5% monthly credit if avg latency > 250ms. Pilot expected usage ~120M tokens/mo. They also asked for Net45 invoicing for the pilot term.
Tara (AE): Customer is a diagnostic lab consortium. If pilot goes well they plan a Q4 roll to Dedicated. ARR upside estimate: $160k/yr.
Noah (Finance): Current list is $0.025/1k tokens. At 20% discount that's $0.02/1k. With the SLA credit we need to model downside. Quick calc: 120M tokens -> $3k list/mo -> $2.4k after 20% off. 5% SLA credit = $120/mo if triggered.
Leah (Sales): They also asked to lock price for 12 months post-pilot if they convert. Is that allowed?
Diego (Deal Desk): We can include a 12-month price protection clause but only up to 10% below then-current list, and it must be tied to a minimum committed ARR. For pilot -> conversion we usually require a committed min of $60k ARR to lock pricing.
Sam (Legal): Also need invoicing terms spelled out. Net45 is unusual for pilots but okay with approval. We need an internal risk acceptance from Finance for extended payment terms.
Noah (Finance): I'm cautious on Net45 for pilots. Suggest compromise: Net30 during pilot with 45-day payment terms for first paid invoice after conversion. Or accept Net45 if they provide a purchase order and initial deposit of $10k to cover credits/waiver.
Leah (Sales): PO + deposit sounds workable. Client can give PO. Will ask about deposit.
Tara (AE): Also note they want explicit data access logging and SOC2 attestation in the addendum. We have SOC2 in general, but addendum should reference our security page.
Sam (Legal): I'll draft addendum referencing SOC2 attestation link and include SLA credit language, payment terms, price protection, and conversion mechanics.
Diego (Deal Desk): Approvals: Deal Desk can approve up to 22% discount for strategic healthcare pilots with PO + deposit. 20% is fine. SLA credits capped at 5% and require objective latency metrics from our monitoring. Must include rollback: if conversion doesn't happen by month 12, pricing reverts to standard.
Noah (Finance): Approve contingent on deposit or signed PO and BillingOps to accept Net45 for pilot only. BillingBot: please flag for BillingOps review.
BillingBot: BillingOps ticket created: BLG-8147 - review Net45 for Cardinal Diagnostics pilot (owner: Maya).
Leah (Sales): Great. I'll secure PO and confirm deposit. If they push for Net45 without deposit we'll decline.
Sam (Legal): I aim to post draft addendum by tomorrow COB.
Tara (AE): Customer verbal ok to PO+deposit path.
Diego (Deal Desk): +1 to 20% discount, SLA credit language, price protection with $60k ARR min, contingent on PO+deposit.
Noah (Finance): +1 conditional on PO/deposit. Once signed, Finance will issue billing override for the pilot price.
Leah (Sales): Thanks team — will update when PO arrives.
BillingBot: Ticket updated BLG-8147 -> awaiting Maya (BillingOps) confirmation.
